label: Hotel Sales (owned and third-party hotels)
purpose: Hotel accommodation bookings of GTE / Dubai Link Direct in AED, for owned and third-party hotels alike ('Hotels'[Is Own] separates them): sales, cost, profit, bookings, room nights, guests and cancellations. Answers 'hotel sales' (all hotels) and 'owned-hotel sales' (with the owned filter).
grain: One hotel booking (reservation line); cancelled bookings stay in the cube, flagged by 'Canceled'[Canceled], with little or no sales.
use_for: owned-hotel sales and owned vs third-party comparison
hotel bookings, room nights, nights, rooms and guests
hotel sales by market, customer, guest nationality, supplier, hotel, chain, star category, destination (hotel country and city), board and channel
not_for: non-hotel services such as visas, tours and transfers (Tickets)
sales per stay night (Sales Average Per Owned Hotels)
average lead time (only the maximum [Booking Window] exists)

coverage.note: Meaningful from 2015 (2014 has only a few dozen bookings); the current month is partial. Arrival dates run to 2028-09 for bookings already made. 2026 sales run well below 2025 from February.

dates.label: Booking date
dates.meaning: When the hotel booking was made (the cube's main date).

dates.label: Arrival (check-in) date
dates.meaning: Check-in date of the stay; runs into the future for bookings already made.

measures.name: [Total Sales]
measures.label: Hotel sales
measures.definition: Selling amount of hotel bookings, in AED. Cancelled bookings keep only small residual amounts, so the total is effectively net of cancellations.
measures.notes: For owned hotels apply the named filter 'owned hotels' ('Hotels'[Is Own] = "Yes"); without it the figure covers all hotels. 'third-party hotel sales' uses the 'third-party hotels' filter.

measures.name: [Total Costs]
measures.label: Hotel cost
measures.definition: Supplier cost of hotel bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: For owned hotels apply the named filter 'owned hotels' ('Hotels'[Is Own] = "Yes"); without it the figure covers all hotels.

measures.name: [Total Profit]
measures.label: Hotel profit
measures.definition: Total Sales minus Total Costs, in AED.
measures.notes: For owned hotels apply the named filter 'owned hotels' ('Hotels'[Is Own] = "Yes"); without it the figure covers all hotels.

measures.name: [Markup]
measures.label: Hotel margin % (profit / sales)
measures.definition: Total Profit divided by Total Sales, despite its name (checked: 2025 profit 10.41M / sales 216.05M = 4.82% = [Markup]).
measures.notes: Name suggests profit/cost but the data is profit/sales; see review item sales_per_owned_hotels.margin_vs_markup.

measures.name: [% Total Profit]
measures.label: Hotel markup % (profit / cost)
measures.definition: Total Profit divided by Total Costs (checked exactly on all-time and 2025 data).

measures.name: [Bookings]
measures.label: Hotel bookings (incl. cancelled)
measures.definition: Number of hotel bookings, cancelled ones included (about 43% of all bookings are cancelled).
measures.notes: Use the 'live bookings' filter for confirmed / non-cancelled bookings. For owned hotels apply the named filter 'owned hotels' ('Hotels'[Is Own] = "Yes"); without it the figure covers all hotels.

measures.name: [Cancellations]
measures.label: Cancelled hotel bookings
measures.definition: Number of cancelled hotel bookings.

measures.name: [% Cancellations]
measures.label: Hotel cancellation rate
measures.definition: Cancellations divided by Bookings.
measures.notes: Only cube with a ready cancellation-rate measure; the Bookings cube may also be asked.

measures.name: [Total Room Nights]
measures.label: Hotel room nights
measures.definition: Rooms multiplied by nights, summed over bookings (cancelled included).
measures.notes: Includes cancelled bookings; add the 'live bookings' filter for stayed / active room nights.

measures.name: [Total Nights]
measures.label: Hotel nights (length of stay)
measures.definition: Sum of each booking's number of nights, not multiplied by rooms (cancelled included).

measures.name: [Total Rooms]
measures.label: Hotel rooms booked
measures.definition: Number of rooms booked (cancelled included).

measures.name: [Total Pax]
measures.label: Hotel guests (pax)
measures.definition: Number of guests on the bookings (cancelled included).

measures.name: [Avg Sales]
measures.label: Average sale per hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Sales divided by Bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: Cancelled bookings (with near-zero sales) are in the denominator, so this understates a live booking's value; add the 'live bookings' filter for that.

measures.name: [Avg Costs]
measures.label: Average cost per hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Costs divided by Bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: Cancelled bookings are in the denominator.

measures.name: [Avg Profit]
measures.label: Average profit per hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Profit divided by Bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: Cancelled bookings are in the denominator.

measures.name: [Avg Nights]
measures.label: Average length of stay
measures.definition: Total Nights divided by Bookings.

measures.name: [Avg Room Nights]
measures.label: Average nights per room
measures.definition: Total Room Nights divided by Total Rooms (checked).

measures.name: [Avg Pax]
measures.label: Average guests per hotel booking
measures.definition: Total Pax divided by Bookings.

measures.name: [Booking Window]
measures.label: Longest booking window (days)
measures.definition: Largest number of days between booking date and arrival date among the bookings in context. It is a maximum, not an average (checked: each lead-time bucket returns its upper bound, all-time 1,070 days).
measures.notes: No average lead-time measure exists: for lead-time questions use [Bookings] by 'Booking Window Interval'[Booking Window Interval].

measures.name: [Original Price Delayed]
measures.label: Original price of re-priced bookings
measures.definition: Original cost of bookings later re-priced by a price-optimisation tool.

measures.name: [Modified Price Delayed]
measures.label: Modified price of re-priced bookings
measures.definition: New cost after a price-optimisation re-pricing.

measures.name: [Price Delayed Profit]
measures.label: Profit from re-priced bookings
measures.definition: Extra profit from re-pricing (original minus modified).

rules: Owned-hotel questions must use the named filter 'owned hotels' ('Hotels'[Is Own] = "Yes"); without it every figure covers all hotels. 'Third-party hotels' is "No".
[Bookings], [Total Room Nights], [Total Nights], [Total Rooms] and [Total Pax] include cancelled bookings; use the 'live bookings' filter when the question says confirmed, active or not cancelled.
[Total Sales], [Total Costs] and [Total Profit] are effectively net of cancellations (cancelled bookings keep only small residual amounts).
[Markup] is profit / sales and [% Total Profit] is profit / cost; percentages and Avg measures are ratios and must never be added across rows. [Booking Window] is a maximum.
Ignore the LY / LYS measures: the app makes period comparisons itself.
Always put a breakdown's needs_columns next to it when grouping or filtering by it.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

'Hotels'[Hotel Country] and 'Hotels'[Hotel City] are the destination; 'Countries'[Country] is the guests' nationality; 'Customers'[Default Country] is the agency's country and 'Customers'[Id Cli] its code ('GTE' + the Bookings cube's 'Customers'[Code]).

review.question: In this cube [Markup] is profit / sales and [% Total Profit] is profit / cost (checked on the data), the opposite of what the names suggest. Which measure answers 'hotel margin %' and which 'hotel markup %'?
review.proposed: 'hotel margin %' -> [Markup] (profit / sales); 'hotel markup %' -> [% Total Profit] (profit / cost)
review.why: Matches the usual business meaning of margin (on sales) and markup (on cost); labels say what each really computes so users are not misled by the cube's names.

review.question: Should 'hotel bookings' / 'owned-hotel bookings' count cancelled bookings (about 43% of all hotel bookings) or only live ones?
review.proposed: [Bookings] (all, cancelled included), with the answer saying cancelled bookings are included
review.why: It is the cube's own definition and the base of [% Cancellations]; sales are already net, so the gap only shows in counts. Users who say confirmed / active get the 'live bookings' filter.
